flags.why: Nhập cư denotes immigration, not the immigrants themselves, who are người nhập cư.
Hiểm meaning dangerous terrain is also used in ordinary speech and is not restricted to literary language ([dictionary](https://www.rung.vn/dict/vn_vn/Hi%E1%BB%83m)).
The everyday verb meaning to twist something is missing ([VOV](https://vovgiaothong.vn/newsaudio/xoan-d31097.html)).
flags.fix: verb | to twist; to twist together

flags.why: The common slang meaning worried or scared, as in Đừng xoắn, is missing ([VOV](https://vovgiaothong.vn/newsaudio/xoan-d31097.html)).
Gia tài commonly means someone's total wealth or possessions without implying inheritance ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/gia-tai-etHiBOqLvlwIR.html)).
flags.fix: noun | fortune; wealth; all someone's possessions
